name: Haus Fr. Kneisl
beschreibung: The inn Haus Fr. Kneisl is located in Pettneu am Arlberg, nestled in the mountains of Tirol. The family-run establishment offers guests traditional and cozy accommodation. The rooms are furnished in Alpine style and have a bathroom, WC, satellite TV and Wi-Fi. In the affiliated restaurant, regional Tiroler specialties are served.
